notes.title: Assist Features Update
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]

[h3]Assist Options Added[/h3]
From the main menu, you can now customize your experience by adjusting:
[list]
[*] Number of lives
[*] Available double jumps
[*] Attack cooldown
[/list]

[h2]Improvements & Fixes[/h2]
Minor visual issues have been resolved for a smoother presentation.
